identity_invariants: Provider organization identity cannot stand in for product identity.
Product identity cannot stand in for an implementation artifact or release.
Implementation artifact cannot stand in for a managed offer.
Managed offer cannot stand in for a deployment or endpoint occurrence.
Source capability class cannot stand in for connector class.
Connector class cannot stand in for connector implementation artifact.
Connector implementation artifact cannot stand in for deployed connector occurrence.
Protocol profile cannot stand in for data model, source authority, or business semantics.
Official documentation cannot stand in for an executed occurrence-scoped qualification receipt.
unknown_policy: material unknowns produce typed gaps or refusals; they are never inferred from provider/product names
